text:
alex: Heads-up — PM asked for a regional/zone dashboard to show latency by region, plus a failover impact view that ties traffic-split changes to latency/error spikes. Need infra/runtime inputs on metrics and labels we can realistically emit.
chris: +1. What are the exact panels we want? p50/p95/p99, request rate, error rate, and traffic split % per region? Also KV cache hit-rate per region would help for tail latency.
sophie: For failover impact we should show traffic % over time (by route/model), latency p95, and 5xx rate. Correlate with routing-policy events so SRE can see when fallback kicked in.
maria: UX ask: make the region DROPDOWN default to last 24h, and have an overlay that highlights rolling 5m windows when traffic was rerouted. Also add a compare mode between primary vs failover region.
alex: Runtime needs: stable metric names, low-cardinality labels, and an event hook for rollout changes. Propose labels: region, zone, route, model_variant, capacity_tier. Avoid including customer_id or request_id on these metrics.
chris: Agree on labels. Also suggest a routing_policy label: {normal, canary, fallback}. For traffic-split, emit a gauge traffic_split_percent{region="us-west1",route="text-gen"} set by the control plane when splits change.
sophie: Sampling: don't sample histograms otherwise p99 will be noisy. We can emit summarized histograms on the runtime — e.g., prometheus histogram buckets for latency. If cardinality explodes we can roll up to region-level only.
alex: infra-bot — can we get confirmation which of these metrics already exist? list of candidates: request_latency_seconds_bucket, request_latency_seconds_sum, request_latency_seconds_count, requests_total{code,region,route}, traffic_split_percent{region,route}, kv_cache_hit_ratio{region}
infra-bot: metrics-scan: Found existing metrics: requests_total (with region,route,code), request_latency_seconds_* present but only at cluster-level (no region label), kv_cache_hit_ratio present for dedicated but not hosted. traffic_split_percent not found.
maria: Ok so action items: (1) Runtime/serving team to add region label to request_latency histograms and kv cache metric to hosted path (2) Control plane to emit traffic_split_percent gauge on change events, with timestamp in annotation (3) Product/Console to design 3 panels: latency heatmap by region, traffic split timeline overlay, failover incident correlate view.
chris: For dashboards use these example queries (promql):
```
# p95 latency per region
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region))
# requests per region
sum(rate(requests_total[1m])) by (region)
# traffic split pct
avg(traffic_split_percent) by (region, route)
```
maria: UX note — add a small table with current quotas and remaining capacity per region (dedicated capacity pools). Also add a link to runbook and a one-click jump that opens the rollout change event in audit logs.
sophie: SRE concern: need an SLO panel showing p99 and error budget burn tied to regional SLOs. Also a synthetic probe reachability metric to detect control-plane split propagation delays.
alex: Timeline: runtime team to prototype labels + traffic gauge by EOD next week, console mock by product in 3 days, then a joint walkthrough. I'll attach a sample dashboard wireframe in the follow-up.
chris: tagging infra-oncall for visibility. @infra-oncall
maria: thanks — I'll update the rollout playbook with the dashboard links once live. :thumbsup:
alex: Thanks everyone — will follow up with a PR and checklist.
